summary: Sample/absence timestamps and detection-time separation are supported by the inspected changes. Two dirty-evidence lifecycle defects remain. Store references mean Sources/DiskStewardCore/EvidenceStore/EvidenceStore.swift within the frozen candidate.

findings.claim: Ancestor dirty paths reset watched descendants but cannot resolve after those descendants complete. With watched /P/a and /P/b, invalidating /P intersects and resets both. Resolution instead requires /P to be inside a completed watched root, so it stays pending indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Use consistent affected-scope semantics for reset and resolution. Track or derive all intersecting watched roots and resolve only when the required ones complete. Test an ancestor signal with two descendants, then repeat with one failed descendant.

findings.claim: Replaying a persisted nonempty FSEvents gap batch resets scan progress again. Existing identical hints take the replay continue branch, but batch.eventGap still unconditionally calls invalidation, which now clears staging and rotates the token. Replaying after recovery also reopens the resolved gap. Repeated retries can prevent convergence without new evidence.
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate the durable gap/reset side effect by receipt or gap-evidence identity, not just hint insertion. Preserve reset behavior for genuinely new equal-timestamp signals and empty-hint gap receipts. Test identical-batch replay during scanning and after complete reconciliation.
